source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/README.md §0.6: 'Nav and masthead render immediately; tiles and rows arrive as skeletons in their final geometry so nothing jumps. A count still loading shows a skeleton, never 0 — a zero is a fact, not a placeholder.'
notes: The design source states a BEHAVIOUR (final-geometry skeletons, never a bare 0) rather than a pixel spec of its own — Skeleton.tsx is checked here for internal consistency against the real components it stands in for: SkeletonListRow's grid must equal ListRow's own grid (spec/listrow.json), SkeletonBandTile's box model must equal BandTile's own (spec/bandtile.json). A skeleton whose geometry drifts from its real component is exactly the 'jumps on load' defect §0.6 rules out.
Skeleton.tsx is pure inline style; every property here is a real product value.

children.name: band-tile skeleton — card box model
children.note: Must equal BandTile's own live box model (spec/bandtile.json): padding 14px 16px 0, radius 10px, min-height 112px.
